These terms cover your use of FreeQrly. They are short on purpose: the service is a free tool, and the rules are mostly common sense.
The service

FreeQrly is a free QR code generator. Static codes need no account and are drawn entirely in your browser. Dynamic codes — editable destinations plus scan statistics — are an optional feature that requires an account.
Prohibited uses
You may not use FreeQrly for:
Phishing — codes that impersonate a login page, a bank, a brand, or any other party to steal credentials or money.
Malware — codes that lead to software meant to harm devices or steal data.
Spam — bulk codes made to flood people with unwanted messages or links.
Illegal content — anything that breaks the law where you are.
Impersonation — codes that pretend to be someone else.
Termination and takedowns
We may suspend accounts and take down codes that violate these terms. If we take down a code, scans of it stop working — that is the one exception to the promise in the next section.
Codes never die

Static codes carry their destination inside the pattern — nothing we do can turn them off, and they keep working forever. Dynamic codes keep working even if you cancel your Pro subscription. The only codes we remove are ones that violate these terms.
Accounts
You are responsible for your account and for keeping your sign-in details safe. We may delete unverified accounts after 30 days — accounts where the email address was never confirmed.
Billing and refunds

FreeQrly is free to use, including 20 dynamic codes with every account. A limited-time promotion currently makes dynamic codes unlimited for every account; when it ends, the 20-code quota applies. We also offer an optional Pro subscription — US$9 per month or US$90 per year — with unlimited dynamic codes. Subscriptions are sold and billed by Waffo Pancake, our merchant of record and payment processor.

By subscribing, you authorize Waffo Pancake to charge your payment method at the start of each billing period until you cancel. You can cancel anytime from your dashboard: Pro stays active until the end of the current period and is not renewed after that.

If this is your first subscription, you can ask for a full refund within 7 days of your first payment — write to hello@freeqrly.com. After those 7 days, payments are not refundable except where the law requires it; cancelling stops future charges but does not refund the current period. Codes you created keep working after a subscription ends — only your limit for creating new dynamic codes returns to the free plan.
